x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given a mapped floor with reservable desks, When an employee books a desk, Then the reservation is confirmed and visible in the space utilisation report Given a facilities fault is logged against a space, When submitted, Then it routes to the facilities group for that building
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: Workplace spaces, reservations and facilities requests are managed in Workplace Service Delivery
